title: Tap to Reveal Controls — 'Live' Live Stream

user_story.role: community member watching a 'Live' live stream
user_story.action: have tapping the player surface reveal the controls instead of toggling pause
user_story.value: not accidentally interrupt the live stream during normal viewing

prioritization._note: Ships with UC1a. Web-Live is net-new build, not a copy of UC1a.

preconditions: User is viewing a 'Live' live stream (Room status: live) on an in-scope surface
entry_points: A. 'Live' stream playing inline in any feed
B. 'Live' stream open in fullscreen / gallery view

platforms._delta: web-Live has no reveal-controls overlay today (bare Plyr, pause/play only) → net-new dev (BR-01/BR-11).

business_rules.statement: Seek/skip (±10s) controls exist only on a video or recorded live stream — never on an active Live stream.
The controls overlay auto-dismisses after 1 second of no interaction while playing; the countdown restarts on every control interaction.
The controls behaviour is identical across all in-scope surfaces (surface-invariant; NOT platform-invariant).
First-tap interaction model is platform-dependent: mobile reveals controls without toggling playback; desktop (Web UIKit) is a direct 1-step pause/play.
Play/pause state changes only via an explicit user pause/play action (BR-09) or a terminal room state — no implicit operation toggles it.
While playing the overlay auto-dismisses (BR-03); while paused it persists and dismisses only on a tap outside the play button, and the media stays paused.
The viewer is never left on a frozen frame with no feedback — any interruption surfaces an explicit state.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Tap playing 'Live' player → controls appear, playback continues (mobile)
given: a 'Live' stream is playing on a mobile surface (iOS / Android / web-on-mobile)
the controls overlay is currently hidden
acceptance_criteria.when: the user taps anywhere on the player surface
then: the controls overlay appears
playback continues uninterrupted — the stream does not pause
the central button shows the pause icon
acceptance_criteria._platform_variance: Desktop = 1-Step Pause (BR-09). web-mobile is in scope for reveal, but note UC2 (pause/resume) is NOT available on web-mobile.
acceptance_criteria._delta: web-Live overlay is net-new — no existing implementation to verify against.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Tap outside button (playing) → overlay dismisses, playback continues
acceptance_criteria.when: the user taps the player surface outside the central pause/play button's tap target
then: the overlay dismisses
playback continues uninterrupted

clarifications_needed.question: Central pause/play button hit-target size/spec?
clarifications_needed.answer: 64x64px per Figma; dev's call on impl (may use native). Test against the rendered 64x64 target.

acceptance_criteria.when: the user takes no further action for 1 second
then: the overlay auto-dismisses
playback continues
acceptance_criteria._delta: web-Live has no overlay/timer today — net-new.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Tap pause ('Live') → pauses; play icon persists; NO seek controls; tap-outside dismisses, stays paused
acceptance_criteria.when: the user taps the central pause button
then: playback pauses
the button icon switches pause→play and remains visible
NO seek controls are shown (a Live stream has no ±10s skip — BR-01)
tapping anywhere outside the play button dismisses the overlay — the stream stays paused
acceptance_criteria._note: Live RESUME behaviour is owned by UC2 (resume → current live edge). Do NOT author a resume AC here.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Behaviour identical across all in-scope surfaces
given: any in-scope surface where a 'Live' stream renders
acceptance_criteria.when: the user performs any of AC-01…AC-04
then: the behaviour is identical regardless of surface

given: a 'Live' stream is actively playing on any in-scope surface
acceptance_criteria.when: the post first renders and no tap has occurred yet
then: no controls overlay is shown — only the live video surface (and the standing LIVE badge / viewer count) is visible

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Idle timer resets on control interaction
given: the user interacts with an overlay control before the 1s timeout elapses
then: the 1s idle countdown restarts — the overlay does not disappear while interacting
after the last interaction the overlay auto-dismisses 1s later

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Pause tap coincides with auto-dismiss timer firing
given: the 1s idle timer is about to fire
acceptance_criteria.when: the user taps the central pause button at that instant
then: playback pauses
the play icon is shown and persists — not caught by the expiring timer
the overlay dismisses only on a subsequent tap-outside

given: the 'Live' stream is buffering (not yet playing)
acceptance_criteria.when: the user taps the player surface
then: the overlay appears
the central button reflects the real state — not a false 'playing' icon
no crash or frozen overlay

acceptance_criteria.scenario: App backgrounded during an active overlay/timer (OS default)
acceptance_criteria.when: the user returns the app to the foreground
then: the player/overlay reach a well-defined state via the OS default (Option 1)
no stale mid-countdown overlay
acceptance_criteria._note: For a 'Live' stream, on foreground the SDK/AVPlayer behaviour governs whether it snaps toward live — see UC2 for the resume-to-live rule.
